decided: When the architect session saves the program's brief, it asks only whether the save worked, not for the brief's whole text, so a session on a large program does not spend its working memory reading the brief each time it opens.
alternatives: change the save so that its machine-readable answer carries only whether a copy was saved and which
why: The session acts only on whether the save failed, and the brief of a large program is hundreds of thousands of characters; leaving the save's own answer as the specs describe it avoids changing a second spec for a reader that does not need it.
